description: This file provides Bash and Zsh shell completion support for Git. It contains functions and logic to enable context-aware command and argument completion for Git commands, subcommands, options, refs, and files within Bash or Zsh shells. The script enables advanced command line completion by parsing command history, current command state, and repository data.

methods.name: __git_find_repo_path
methods.description: Finds the absolute path to the Git repository, considering options like '--git-dir' and '-C'.

methods.name: __git
methods.description: Runs the 'git' command with the given arguments, respecting configured options.

methods.name: __git_eread
methods.description: Reads the first line of a specified file into a variable.

methods.name: __git_dequote
methods.description: Removes backslash escaping and quotes from a string.

methods.name: __git_count_path_components
methods.description: Counts slash-separated components in a given path.
